structure.title: 对世界观的简短描述，展开小三角查看详细说明。
structure.summary: A brief overview of a fictional world in which, in 2067, a parapsychology experiment on Vozrozhdeniye Island (nicknamed Red Island for its blood-red appearance on satellite maps) causes another dimension to intrude, drawing in two mercenaries tasked by a shadowy client to investigate and survive until rescue arrives. The island’s notorious anthrax leak is revealed as a cover for earlier, secret 1986 Soviet “Frontal Lobe” experiments aimed at replicating supernatural events from a Ural Mountains laboratory, which inadvertently killed many personnel.

structure.title: **特殊设定**
structure.summary: 概述了一个特殊设定：提供具有特殊说明意义的旧物与资料补充，并提到同时间线中另一大陆的设定与主世界的对比。该事件源自“世界观:自私的基因”中高维强磁场影响，时间线同步。两个世界观差异在于另一大陆受影响表现为“物”作用于“自然”，导致高杀伤力、反复爆发、人类抗争引发近乎毁灭的灾变，基调侧重对抗；而本大陆的影响体现为“共联”作用于“机械”，畸变机械具备思考能力，杀伤力低且能与人类共存，理智觉醒较早，使得整体基调指向共生。
